name: Beyond3Baje Documentary Production
description: Premium 13-stage documentary pipeline from deep historical research to script breakdown, shot lists, voice recording, edit plans, and analytics.

steps.name: Research
steps.description: Perform deep historical/factual research and gather story hooks and reference sources.

steps.name: Scripting
steps.description: Draft the full script containing narration V.O. and detailed scene structures.

steps.name: Scene Breakdown
steps.description: Deconstruct the script into discrete production scenes with timing estimates.

steps.name: Shot List
steps.description: Create a detailed visual shot list detailing camera motions and framing for every scene.

steps.name: Clip Planning
steps.description: Search asset library and identify matching stock footage or animation styles.

steps.name: AI Image Planning
steps.description: Formulate descriptive AI generation prompts for Midjourney/Stable Diffusion for missing clips.

steps.name: Asset Collection
steps.description: Consolidate visual footage clips, icons, animations, and image files.

steps.name: Voice Recording
steps.description: Generate or plan voiceover narration transcripts and audio requirements.

steps.name: Editing
steps.description: Formulate detailed video editing instructions (timing, LUT overlays, music beats, transition templates).

steps.name: Review
steps.description: Fact-check the edit draft and verify that it matches the brand channel style guide.

steps.name: SEO Setup
steps.description: Generate high-CTR titles, optimized search tags, description hooks, and hashtags.

steps.name: Publishing
steps.description: Run metadata checks and plan release schedule.

steps.name: Analytics
steps.description: Conduct performance reviews and extract audience feedback insights for knowledge archives.
